tables.name: Ordon Naming Method
tables.description: Which naming method an Ordon settlement name uses. Each result is a naming method; its faces are its weight (starter weights 70% / 30%).

results.name: Geographic Compound
results.description: First element + second element, in restrained Old English / medieval British style, e.g. Alderwick.

results.name: Historical Founder
results.description: A founder's name + a settlement ending, possessive where English place names are, e.g. Godwinsbury.
